ranked.headline: Learned representations are resolving spatial and single-cell omics at multiple scales
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell datasets are growing in scale and modality, prompting foundation models, QC frameworks and deconvolution tools.

ranked.headline: Pretrained structure models repurposed for generative protein and peptide design
ranked.summary: Diffusion, score-distillation, and RL-based design methods now target de novo binders and pockets with explicit physical or preference constraints.

ranked.headline: RNA structure methods pair folding models with geometric, template, and raw-signal data
ranked.summary: Blind benchmarking and new geometric and nanopore datasets now test RNA structure methods beyond sequence alone.

ranked.headline: Supervised and transfer-learning models classify cancer subtypes from multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Transfer learning, meta-learning, and ensemble stacking are being applied to heterogeneous omics inputs for subtype and outcome prediction.

ranked.headline: MD and ML approaches resolve conformational states, solvation and selectivity
ranked.summary: Recent MD studies separate residue-specific contacts from net charge and resolve solvation and selectivity determinants at atomistic detail.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics traces gene family gain and loss across mammals and plants
ranked.summary: Broad phylogenetic sampling across 73 mammalian and 446 plant genomes now enables lineage-resolved inference of gene family history.

ranked.headline: Large-scale genome mining links sequence content to defined microbial systems and traits
ranked.summary: Rapidly growing genome and metagenome collections now allow tools to assign system, resistance, and structural classes across millions of sequences.

ranked.headline: Graph networks predict drug-target affinity, synergy, and gene-pair interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply attention, multi-view, and adversarial graph designs to heterogeneous biomedical networks for interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Deep learning recovers latent temporal and regulatory structure from static omics profiles
ranked.summary: Deep models now reconstruct dynamics, phases, and regulatory networks from untimed, sparsely sampled, or context-mixed omics data.

ranked.headline: AI models predict drug synergy, epitope immunogenicity, and viral infectivity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply LLMs, HyenaDNA, and LSTM/CNN architectures to biomolecular prediction, emphasizing pipelines and knowledge bases.

ranked.headline: Attention and pretrained genomic models target bacterial resistance and interactions
ranked.summary: Preprints from late December 2025 pair pretrained or attention-based sequence models with bacterial resistance, interaction and phenotype prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Multilocus models refine genetic architecture from summary and sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent studies extend polygenic and multilocus inference to diverse ancestries, single-cell annotations, and oligogenic effects.

ranked.headline: Ensemble and network-aware models extend protein prediction across microbial data
ranked.summary: Genome-wide and metagenome-scale predictors now combine pretrained protein language models with classical sequence and interaction-network methods.

ranked.headline: Data-driven tools decode mutations, mutational signatures, and T-ALL leukemia subtypes
ranked.summary: BASCULE applies to ~8000 samples and DORM restricts inputs to whole-genome and whole-exome data, sharpening sequencing-based inference of tumor features.

ranked.headline: Confinement drives chiral rotation; epigenetic feedback reshapes cell-state landscapes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply phase-field, mean-field and Fisher-information tools to single-cell state transitions and regulatory dynamics.

ranked.headline: Methods for estimating complex trait architecture from GWAS summary and biomarker data
ranked.summary: Faster local heritability estimation, telomere-length calibration, and below-LOD handling address precision limits in current GWAS and biomarker workflows.

ranked.headline: DNA sequence encodes enhancers, replication origins and nucleosome occupancy
ranked.summary: Three December 2025 preprints dissect how intrinsic DNA sequence, including transposon-derived elements, shapes immune enhancers, origins and nucleosomes.

ranked.headline: Primer and amplicon workflows refine targeted sequencing enrichment and read resolution
ranked.summary: Validated, accessible targeted-sequencing tools are being released for reproducible primer design, viral enrichment in surveillance, and nanopore DNA barcoding.

ranked.headline: Protein AI models expand conformer sampling and in silico evolution; developability lags
ranked.summary: Late-December 2025 studies test co-folding, ensemble sampling and language-model design against prospective screens and large benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Conditional generative models target pathogen-specific antimicrobial peptide design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair generative models with property predictors to prioritise peptides and small molecules for antibacterial activity.

ranked.headline: ML priors now guide cryo-EM reconstruction and electron microscopy acquisition
ranked.summary: Generative and machine-learning models are being embedded in cryo-EM heterogeneity analysis and real-time electron microscopy acquisition.

ranked.headline: Computable models of tissue transport, signaling, and mechanics in multicellular systems
ranked.summary: Explicit computational models now couple ciliary transport, corneal homeostasis, EGFR signaling, and epithelial mechanochemistry to tissue-scale behavior.

ranked.headline: Latent dynamical models of neural activity are extended and judged beyond prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend nonlinear latent dynamics to human iEEG, and a published study proposes a metric that selects latents beyond predictive accuracy.

ranked.headline: Cell-type-resolved atlases map expression and splicing variation across mouse and human
ranked.summary: Single-nucleus and single-cell profiling now resolves regeneration, aging-associated splicing, and strain-level expression variation at cell-type resolution.

ranked.headline: Population variants and sequence diversity shape CRISPR guide and construct design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show population variants alter CRISPR-Cas guide on-target activity across 79,648 genomes, motivating variant-aware gRNA design.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and deep learning for microbiome network, phage-host, and disease inference
ranked.summary: Simulation benchmarks and deep architectures with biological structure are now being applied to core microbiome inference tasks.

ranked.headline: Agents chain target discovery, pocket design, and PK simulation for therapeutic design
ranked.summary: Agentic LLM systems are now being built to link target assessment, structure-based design, and pharmacokinetic simulation with verifiable evidence.

ranked.headline: Reproducible software infrastructure packaging curated biological datasets for analysis
ranked.summary: Analysis capability is increasingly delivered as maintained infrastructure coupled to provenance, metadata and access across biological domains.

ranked.headline: Interpretable factorization and feature curation refine single-cell representations
ranked.summary: Scalable NMF of 28.5M healthy cells and LLM marker curation test how feature construction shapes single-cell annotation and embeddings.

ranked.headline: Imposing explicit causal and design structure on high-dimensional molecular data
ranked.summary: High-dimensional molecular datasets now demand causal instruments, designed perturbations, and formal decision models beyond association.
